items.title: UAE｜Al Maktoum International Airport西航站楼AED100亿地基与下部结构包已选定承包商
items.title_en: UAE | Al Maktoum International Airport western terminal AED10bn substructure package contractor selected
items.summary: Dubai Aviation Engineering Projects已为Al Maktoum International Airport西航站楼首期选定约AED10 billion的下部结构承包商，由CCECC与Tristar Engineering & Construction联合体执行。西航站楼规划约800,000平方米、7层、年旅客吞吐量约4,500万人次。
items.summary_en: Dubai Aviation Engineering Projects has selected the contractor for the first-phase substructure package of the western terminal at Al Maktoum International Airport, valued at about AED10 billion. The package will be delivered by a CCECC and Tristar Engineering & Construction consortium. The terminal is planned at roughly 800,000 sq m over seven levels with annual capacity of around 45 million passengers.
items.why_it_matters: 这是超大型机场扩建进入核心土建执行阶段的重要节点，而且中国承包商已进入主合同层级，后续供应链和专业分包机会非常明确。
items.why_it_matters_en: This marks a major step into execution for a mega airport expansion, with a Chinese contractor already at prime-contract level, creating clear downstream supply-chain and specialist subcontracting opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注地基、混凝土、钢结构、机电、行李系统、登机桥、照明、消防、幕墙、机场设备、施工机械及中国供应链配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track foundations, concrete, steel structures, MEP, baggage handling, boarding bridges, lighting, fire systems, facades, airport equipment, construction machinery and Chinese supply-chain participation.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜Mohammed V机场新航站楼再释放约MAD4.8亿三项采购
items.title_en: Morocco | Mohammed V Airport releases three new procurement packages worth about MAD480m
items.summary: ONDA为Casablanca Mohammed V机场新航站楼推出三项采购，总预算约MAD480 million，其中包括约47座登机桥、60套地面供电转换设备、61套飞机引导系统、新道路互通及工程质量监督。
items.summary_en: ONDA has launched three procurement packages for the new terminal at Casablanca Mohammed V Airport with a combined budget of about MAD480 million, including 47 passenger boarding bridges, 60 ground power conversion units, 61 aircraft guidance systems, new road interchange works and quality-control services.
items.why_it_matters: 这是大型机场总项目向专业设备和配套工程拆分采购的明确节点，设备、道路和监理三个入口都具备直接商业价值。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a clear package-release phase within a major airport programme, creating direct opportunities across specialist equipment, access roads and supervision services.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注登机桥、机场地面电源、飞机泊位引导、道路互通、照明、机电、检测监理及机场专业设备。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track boarding bridges, ground power units, aircraft docking guidance, road interchanges, lighting, MEP, inspection and supervision, and specialist airport equipment.

items.title: 阿曼｜125MW Dhofar II Wind IPP进入建设推进期
items.title_en: Oman | 125MW Dhofar II Wind IPP advances through construction
items.summary: Naseem Dhofar SAOC正推进125MW Dhofar II Wind IPP。项目位于Dhofar，由Sembcorp Utilities持股75%、OQ Alternative Energy持股25%，已于2026年6月开工，目标2027年第三季度商业运行。
items.summary_en: Naseem Dhofar SAOC is advancing the 125MW Dhofar II Wind IPP in Dhofar. The project is 75% owned by Sembcorp Utilities and 25% by OQ Alternative Energy, entered construction in June 2026 and targets commercial operation in Q3 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 项目已经进入设备、施工和并网交付阶段，风机、塔筒、电气及运维相关供应链机会开始具备执行价值。
items.why_it_matters_en: The project is now in equipment, construction and grid-delivery phases, creating actionable opportunities across turbines, towers, electrical systems and O&M.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注风机、塔筒、电缆、变压器、升压站、SCADA、储能配套、道路基础、吊装及风电运维。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track turbines, towers, cables, transformers, substations, SCADA, storage interfaces, access roads, heavy lifting and wind O&M.

items.title: UAE｜Abu Dhabi Al Reem Island Seamont住宅项目AED8亿主合同落地
items.title_en: UAE | AED800m main construction contract awarded for Seamont residences on Al Reem Island
items.summary: Fibrex Construction Group获得AED800 million的Seamont Autograph Collection Residences主体建设合同。项目位于Al Reem Island，由Royal Development Holding与Saas Properties开发，包括两栋22层住宅塔楼、497套住宅，预计2028年12月完成。
items.summary_en: Fibrex Construction Group has secured the AED800 million main construction contract for Seamont Autograph Collection Residences on Al Reem Island. Developed by Royal Development Holding and Saas Properties, the project includes two 22-storey residential towers with 497 residences and is targeted for completion in December 2028.
items.why_it_matters: 项目已进入主体施工阶段，后续专业分包和材料设备采购会持续释放。
items.why_it_matters_en: The project has entered main construction, creating a continuing pipeline for specialist subcontracting, materials and building systems.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注幕墙、门窗、MEP、卫浴、石材、照明、厨房、家具、智能家居、景观及室内装修。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track facades, doors and windows, MEP, sanitaryware, stone, lighting, kitchens, furniture, smart-home systems, landscaping and interior fit-out.

items.title: 西班牙｜Astigarraga车站轨道与电气化工程新招标，约€192万
items.title_en: Spain | Astigarraga station track and electrification works tender launched at about €1.92m
items.summary: ADIF发布Astigarraga通勤铁路车站轨道上部结构与电气化工程公开招标，估值约€1.92 million，工期4个月，投标截止2026年11月3日。工程包括新轨道、接触网调整、信号设备迁移及两条新侧线电气化。
items.summary_en: ADIF has launched an open tender for track superstructure and electrification works at Astigarraga commuter station, valued at about €1.92 million with a four-month delivery period and bids due by 3 November 2026. Scope includes new track, catenary modifications, signalling relocation and electrification of two new sidings.
items.why_it_matters: 这是轨道+电气化的专业施工包，金额适中，进入门槛低于大型总包，更适合专业供应商和分包商切入。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a specialist track-and-electrification package with a more accessible scale than major EPC contracts, making it relevant to niche suppliers and subcontractors.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注轨道、接触网、电缆、绝缘子、道岔、信号、施工设备及西班牙本地铁路工程合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track rail, catenary, cables, insulators, turnouts, signalling, construction equipment and Spanish rail-engineering partnerships.

items.title: 非洲｜美国DFC计划扩大非洲股权投资，WIOCC数字基建US$1.55亿成为标志性项目
items.title_en: Africa | U.S. DFC plans more African equity investment, with US$155m WIOCC digital infrastructure deal a flagship example
items.summary: 美国DFC计划进一步扩大在非洲的股权投资，目前在非洲投资组合已超过US$14 billion，其中对泛非数字基础设施公司WIOCC投资US$155 million，重点领域还包括关键矿产与Lobito Corridor等运输基础设施。
items.summary_en: The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation plans to expand equity investment in Africa, where its portfolio already exceeds US$14 billion. Its US$155 million investment in pan-African digital infrastructure company WIOCC is a flagship example, alongside priorities in critical minerals and transport infrastructure such as the Lobito Corridor.
items.why_it_matters: 非洲数字基础设施融资正在加速，未来数据中心、海缆、城域光纤和跨境网络项目将更活跃。
items.why_it_matters_en: Digital infrastructure financing in Africa is accelerating, likely supporting a larger pipeline of data centers, subsea cable, metro fibre and cross-border network projects.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注海缆、光纤、数据中心、网络设备、边缘节点、云基础设施、网络安全，以及中国设备商与非洲本地运营商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track subsea cable, fibre, data centers, network equipment, edge nodes, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity and partnerships between Chinese vendors and African operators.

items.title: 墨西哥｜Querétaro–Saltillo客运铁路122公里区段仍处国际公开招标窗口
items.title_en: Mexico | 122km Querétaro–Saltillo passenger rail section remains in international public tender window
items.summary: Proyectos México当前列出Querétaro–Saltillo客运铁路San Luis Potosí–Charcas约122公里区段为公开招标机会；相关线路还包括57公里Charcas–Vanegas段、93公里Vanegas–Zacatecano段等，采购内容涉及铁路设计、桥梁、隧道、上下跨线桥和配套工程。
items.summary_en: Proyectos México currently lists the approximately 122 km San Luis Potosí–Charcas section of the Querétaro–Saltillo passenger railway as an open tender opportunity. Related packages also include the 57 km Charcas–Vanegas and 93 km Vanegas–Zacatecano sections, covering railway design, bridges, tunnels, grade separations and associated works.
items.why_it_matters: 这是新的土建施工区段，不是此前车辆采购的重复信息，对工程承包和材料供应链更直接。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a new civil-works section rather than a repeat of earlier rolling-stock procurement, making it more directly relevant to contractors and construction supply chains.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注桥梁、隧道、路基、钢结构、预制构件、轨道、施工机械、工程物流及墨西哥本地联合体合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track bridges, tunnels, earthworks, steel structures, precast components, track, construction machinery, project logistics and Mexican consortium partnerships.
